# Synthetic Type 1 font

`trepdf-test-mono.pfa` is generated by `python3 generate.py` in this folder.
It contains original rectangle outlines with distinct ink widths and a constant
500-unit advance. No external font program or license is included.

The fixture exercises raw Type 1 loading, private-family isolation, Unicode
mapping and mixed-font inline editing without depending on an installed font
or a user's PDF. The rectangles intentionally are not a readable UI font.
